claim: Temporary liquidity imbalance causes a price concession followed by partial recovery.
why_it_might_persist: Compensation for supplying immediacy and bearing inventory risk. It persists because someone must be paid to take the other side, not because nobody has noticed.
observable_prediction: Reversal magnitude increases with measured liquidity stress, monotonically across preregistered spread buckets.
falsifier: No ordered relationship between liquidity stress and subsequent reversal, at or above the minimum observation count.
